title: Money and shopping
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a zsebpénzről, a spórolásról, a vásárlásról és a pénzügyeidről kérdez. Válaszolj több mondatban, és indokold a véleményedet.

questions.q: Do you get pocket money? What do you spend it on?
followUps: Do you think you get enough?

questions.q: Are you good at saving money? Are you saving for anything at the moment?
What was the last thing you bought for yourself?
Where do you usually go shopping for food and clothes?
Do you or your family buy things online? What?
followUps: What are the good and bad sides of online shopping?

questions.q: Who does the shopping in your family?
Do you prefer paying by card or in cash? Why?
What is expensive for teenagers in Hungary today?
If you got 100,000 forints as a present, what would you do with it?

usefulPhrases.en: I get ... forints a week / a month.
I'm saving up for a new phone.
I spend most of my money on ...
I pay by card most of the time.
I'd put it in the bank.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you get pocket money? What do you spend it on?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, my parents give me ten thousand forints a month. I mostly spend it on snacks at school and on going out with my friends, for example to the cinema.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you think you get enough?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Well, it's enough for me, because my parents still pay for my clothes and my phone bill.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Are you good at saving money? Are you saving for anything at the moment?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Not really, to be honest, but I'm trying. At the moment I'm saving for a new pair of headphones, so I put two thousand forints aside every month.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you or your family buy things online? What?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, quite often. My mum orders books online, and I bought my football boots on a website last spring because they were much cheaper there. The only problem is that things sometimes arrive late.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: If you got 100,000 forints as a present, what would you do with it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I would put most of it in the bank, because I'll need money for driving lessons next year. With the rest, I would buy a concert ticket.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: minden válasz kifejtett és indokolt, a vizsgázó a vizsgáztató rákérdezésére (Do you think you get enough?) is érdemben, okkal felel, nem csak igennel vagy nemmel.
Szókincs: a pénzügyek témaköréhez illő, pontos kifejezéseket használ (pocket money, phone bill, put aside, save for, arrive late).

Nyelvhelyesség: az éppen zajló dolgot folyamatos jelen fejezi ki (I'm saving for), a múltbeli vásárlást egyszerű múlt (bought), a feltételes kérdésre pedig helyes feltételes módban válaszol (I would put …).
Érdemes megtanulni: „I'm saving for a new pair of headphones”, „I put … aside every month”, „The only problem is that …”, „With the rest, I would …”.
